description: Canonical Track 3 trace.parquet column and event-vocabulary registry. The authoritative JSON Schema is common/schemas/sim_scenario.schema.json; this file enumerates the exact column dtypes and message-type strings used by the regression harness (regression_suite/run_regression.py) and the baseline adapter (baselines/abides_fork/). Submissions must emit exactly these columns and message-type strings.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.description: id of the agent that emitted the event; the exchange is agent 0

columns.name: msg_type
columns.description: canonical message type; one of msg_types below

columns.name: side
columns.description: order/quote side: BID, ASK, or null

columns.name: price
columns.description: price in integer ticks; 0 where not applicable

columns.name: size
columns.description: quantity in integer lots; 0 where not applicable

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: originating order id; -1 for events with no order (e.g. QUOTE_UPDATE)

semantics.notes: ORDER_FILLED is the final fill for an order_id; earlier fills of the same order_id are PARTIAL_FILL. QUOTE_UPDATE carries the resting best price for its side at t_ns (one row per (t_ns, side)).
